vocab.example: My base salary is fixed, but the bonus depends on the project result.
vocab.example_vi: Lương cơ bản của tôi là cố định, nhưng thưởng phụ thuộc vào kết quả dự án.

vocab.example: Every engineer level has its own salary band in our company.
vocab.example_vi: Mỗi cấp bậc kỹ sư đều có khung lương riêng trong công ty chúng tôi.

vocab.meaning_vi: đề nghị ngược lại (mức lương khác)

vocab.example: The probation period is two months, and then we review your work.

listening.title: Talking about salary and benefits with HR

lines.speaker: Linh (HR Manager)
lines.text: Thanks for coming, Nam. Today I would like to talk about your new offer.

lines.speaker: Nam (Senior Developer)
lines.text: Thank you, Linh. Could you start with the base salary, please?

lines.speaker: Linh (HR Manager)
lines.text: Of course. The base salary is forty million dong per month, before tax.

lines.speaker: Nam (Senior Developer)
lines.text: I see. May I ask where that sits inside the salary band for my level?

lines.speaker: Linh (HR Manager)
lines.text: It is in the middle of the band. Strong reviews can move you higher next year.

lines.speaker: Nam (Senior Developer)
lines.text: Understood. I would like to make a small counter-offer of forty-four million.

lines.speaker: Linh (HR Manager)
lines.text: I can go to forty-two, and I will add a performance bonus twice a year.

lines.speaker: Nam (Senior Developer)
lines.text: That sounds fair. What about health insurance and the training budget?

lines.speaker: Linh (HR Manager)
lines.text: Health insurance covers your family, and you have twenty million for training each year.

lines.speaker: Nam (Senior Developer)
lines.text: Great. One last question: is there overtime pay during the probation period?

lines.speaker: Linh (HR Manager)
lines.text: Yes, from your first day. I will send the full offer letter this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Nam (Senior Developer)
lines.text: Perfect. I will read it carefully and reply to you before Friday.
